description:
You wrap yourself in a dense mantle of astral force, sharpening your defensive instincts at the cost of speed.
The mantle slows your movements and attacks while greatly increasing your parry chance.
Its strength scales with your magic power and is further amplified by any Astral Wisps you currently control.
Sustaining the mantle builds Astral Fatigue, risking Overdrawn backlash if maintained too long.
This empowerment affects only you and cannot be shared.
name: Astral Mantle
